user_report: Prove one translation estimator offline on: 10 stationary frames per camera (pairwise near-zero shifts); known 10-1000 px software shifts; real physical before/after pairs. It must work on both a textured terrestrial frame and a sparse star/point-source frame (issue #32) through one production interface.

cases.name: stationary_main_pair_00_01_is_zero
cases.rationale: Two consecutive same-camera frames captured with the rig static and the mount not commanded between them. The true displacement is zero by construction of the capture, not by anything the estimator reports; tolerance covers sub-pixel centroid noise only.

cases.name: stationary_guide_pair_00_01_is_zero
cases.rationale: As stationary_main_pair_00_01_is_zero, for the Guide camera. Zero shift is a property of the static capture; the estimator must not invent motion.

cases.name: known_shift_guide_x_120px
cases.rationale: guide_roll_x120.fits is numpy.roll(guide_base.fits, 120, axis=1) — an exact, known software translation of a real frame. Independent of the estimator (numpy, not measure_translation_offset).

cases.name: known_shift_guide_xy_640_360px
cases.rationale: numpy.roll(guide_base.fits, (360, 640), axis=(0, 1)) — a large, exact, known 2-D software translation. Exercises the 10-1000 px end of the range.

cases.name: real_physical_guide_axis1_af7d27b7
cases.rationale: A real mount-pulse before/after pair (diagnostic af7d27b7). Expected value is the shift recorded in that bundle's own incident.json calibration.right.axis1, cross-checked as non-degenerate against the orthogonal axis2 vector from the same run — not read back from measure_translation_offset.

cases.name: star_field_guide_pair_through_same_interface
cases.rationale: Issue #32: a sparse point-source (star) before/after pair fed through the SAME measure_translation_offset entry point as the textured terrestrial cases. A usable match is required; dx/dy pins are added once the pair's true shift is measured by hand (star centroids) and recorded here.
